App Factory: ~40% → production-operational

Then prove that the App Factory can autonomously build a REAL
application end-to-end.

==================================================

==================================================

- 12/12 core IA agents
- specialized agents
- 50 factory agents
- factory engine
- factory templates
- autonomous queue
- owner approval gates
- QA gates
- security gates
- deployment pipeline

Do not trust previous narrative summaries.

Return real IDs/status/evidence.

==================================================
2. OWNER AUTHORIZATION
==================================================

OWNER AUTHORIZATION IS GRANTED to activate the existing
50 provisioned App Factory agents needed for this completion program,
subject to existing security, QA, budget, and release gates.

This authorization does NOT permit:

- bypassing security
- bypassing QA
- exposing credentials
- destructive production changes without safeguards
- uncontrolled spending
- removing owner-only controls
- automatically publishing apps to public stores without the
  required owner/store approval

Record this authorization in the audit trail.

==================================================
3. VERIFY 12 FACTORY AGENT CLASSES
==================================================

Execute:

AF-VERIFY-001
through
AF-VERIFY-012

Each verification must prove real execution.

Required gates:

IA-12 Security
IA-03 QA

AGENT ID
ROLE
REAL TASK
INPUT
OUTPUT
TOOLS USED
SECURITY RESULT
QA RESULT
STATUS

No simulated PASS.

==================================================
4. ACTIVATE FACTORY AGENTS
==================================================

Activate the 50 provisioned factory agents in controlled batches.

For every agent record:

AGENT ID
SPECIALTY
ACTIVATION TIME
STATUS
QUEUE
CURRENT TASK
LAST COMPLETED TASK
QA STATUS

Failed verification:
DO NOT ACTIVATE.

==================================================
5. ENABLE 24/7 AUTONOMOUS OPERATION
==================================================

Configure IVX Autonomous/App Factory for persistent operation.

It must:

- continuously process approved queued work
- persist jobs across restarts
- recover abandoned jobs
- prevent duplicate execution
- enforce concurrency limits
- enforce retry limits
- enforce cost/budget limits
- log every action
- expose queue depth
- expose worker health
- expose failures/blockers
- escalate only when human/owner intervention is genuinely required

24/7 does NOT mean uncontrolled execution.

It means persistent, governed autonomous execution.

==================================================
6. COMPLETE REMAINING 12-IA WORK
==================================================

Use the appropriate IVX agents to close the remaining verified
software gaps in the 12-IA system.

Do not ask the owner to perform engineering work that IVX can
perform itself.

For every remaining item:

DISCOVER
→ PLAN
→ EXECUTE
→ TEST
→ SECURITY REVIEW
→ QA
→ DEPLOY
→ VERIFY

If something genuinely requires external credentials,
hardware or owner/legal approval:
mark EXTERNAL-BLOCKED.

Do not fabricate completion.

==================================================
7. FIRST REAL FACTORY PILOT
==================================================

Execute the existing:

AF-PILOT-001

This is the critical autonomy proof.

IVX App Factory must build a REAL working application.

The factory must perform:

→ ANALYTICS/OBSERVABILITY
→ SUPPORT/MAINTENANCE HANDOFF

Rork must NOT build the pilot.

Rork audits the evidence.

AGENT IDs
TASK IDs
FILES CREATED
FILES MODIFIED
REAL DIFFS

TEST RESULTS

IVX IA
RORK
HUMAN
EXTERNAL
UNKNOWN

PASS requires the implementation to be materially executed
by IVX/App Factory.

==================================================
9. SENIOR DEVELOPER SUPERVISION
==================================================

SD-0001 must supervise engineering decisions.

It must:

- review architecture
- review implementation
- detect incomplete work
- reject weak solutions
- assign corrections
- enforce testing
- enforce production verification

RM-0001 must enforce release gates.

IA-03 must independently QA.

IA-12 must independently security-review.

The developer cannot self-certify its own work.

==================================================
10. CONTINUOUS FAILURE RECOVERY
==================================================

24/7 operation must prove recovery from:

- worker restart
- job interruption
- provider timeout
- GitHub/API rate limit
- failed test
- failed deployment
- database/transient failure
- duplicate task attempt

A failed task must not disappear.

It must become:

RETRYING
BLOCKED
FAILED
or
ESCALATED

with evidence.

==================================================

==================================================

IDLE AGENTS
FAILED AGENTS
QUEUE DEPTH
RUNNING JOBS
COMPLETED JOBS
FAILED JOBS

SECURITY STATUS

PAUSE
RESUME
APPROVE
REJECT

factory execution.

==================================================
12. NO RORK DEPENDENCY
==================================================

After activation, prove IVX continues operating when Rork is
not actively executing anything.

Rork may audit.

Rork must NOT be required for:

- queue processing
- agent execution
- coding
- testing
- GitHub operations
- deployment
- monitoring
- recovery

==================================================
13. RUN UNTIL SOFTWARE WORK IS COMPLETE
==================================================

Continue processing approved internal completion tasks
autonomously.

Do not stop merely because one batch finishes.

Continue until:

A. all software-completable 12-IA items are complete, AND

B. factory agents required for production operation are verified
and active, AND

C. AF-PILOT-001 has completed the full software lifecycle, AND

D. production verification passes.

Stop/escalate only for a genuine external blocker requiring:

- physical device
- App Store/Play Store owner action
- legal/business approval
- unavailable external service
- owner-only financial authorization
- other genuinely non-automatable owner action
